answer.rationale: Negotiating terms with the incumbent is the only action that can meet the 18% cost-cut mandate within 14 days without increasing delivery risk. Historical evidence (memory_c4: renegotiation recovered margin via benchmarking; memory_c6: multi-year commitments unlocked volume pricing) proves cost reductions are achievable with the current supplier. Switching vendors (memory_c2) or adding a second source (memory_c3) would risk supply disruption at 94% line utilization; renewing as-is (memory_c1) fails the cost mandate; deferring (memory_c5) risks contract loss. Negotiation preserves stability while targeting the required savings.
